title: SCP HUB
features:
Info Tab — live ping, FPS counter, player count
Farm Tab — auto orb farm (select orb type, multiplier slider), infinite orb (all types), auto hoops, auto rebirth, auto race win
Misc Tab — claim all gifts, spin fortune wheel, redeem all codes, collect all chests, trade spam
Player Tab — speed hack (slider 16-1000), jump power (slider 0-1500), infinite jump, FPS cap slider, noclip, reset character
Teleport Tab — 6 locations, teleport to player (dropdown), world server hop (city/space/desert)
Server Tab — job ID, place ID, copy job ID, rejoin, server hop
